headline: Node-RED flaw CVE-2026-58115 exploited to deploy Linux bot; Synology NAS ransomware and Ivanti zero-days remain active

bullets.text: New: Help Net Security reports attackers are exploiting critical Node-RED flaw CVE-2026-58115 to deploy a Linux bot and backdoors. The Hacker News ties the same CVE to Siemens IoT2050 devices, where it is used to plant remote command backdoors.
New: NCSC's chief warns the UK will face AI-powered attacks on critical infrastructure within two years. The Register, SecurityWeek and NCSC all carry it. This is a forecast, not an active incident.

The Hacker News reports ransomware attacks on Synology NAS devices exploiting a patched DSM flaw, and attackers targeting an unpatched CryptoPayment gateway flaw, CVE-2026-81648, that can expose wallet credentials.

Connect Secure, 4 outlets: Ivanti patched two more zero-days chained in attacks, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527. CISA KEV lists CVE-2026-104935 in the same product, with federal due dates of 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-13.
BleepingComputer reports over 1,000 GitLab servers are vulnerable to ongoing RCE attacks. CISA KEV lists GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229, whose federal due date passed on 2026-11-01.
Binance, 7 outlets: The Register reports the FBI pins the $6.3B heist on North Korean hackers. SecurityWeek says the FBI flagged over 600 addresses tied to it.

actions: Find Node-RED instances and Siemens IoT2050 devices, patch CVE-2026-58115 per vendor guidance, and look for backdoors. Isolate exposed ones you cannot patch.
Update DSM on Synology NAS devices, restrict their internet exposure, and confirm backups are intact.
Patch GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) and Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418) now; both KEV due dates have passed. Check GitLab servers for signs of RCE.
Apply Ivanti's latest Connect Secure patches, covering CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, and check appliances for compromise.
If you run a CryptoPayment gateway, restrict access until CVE-2026-81648 is patched and rotate any wallet credentials it holds.
If you handle crypto transactions, screen against the addresses the FBI flagged for the Binance heist.
